content.query:
SELECT 
[TradeStatus]
,STG.[Trade_Id]
,[External_Reference]
,[Product_Type]
,[Bundle_Type]
,[Bundle_Name]
,[Bundle_Id]
,[Book]
,[Product_Description]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(Entered_Date, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as Entered_Date
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(Trade_date, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as Trade_date
,convert(date,[Trade_Settle_Date]) as Trade_Settle_Date
,convert(date,[Maturity_Date]) as Maturity_Date
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(FXNDF_Reset_Date, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as FXNDF_Reset_Date
,[CounterParty_ID]
,[CounterParty_Short_Name]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(TRADE_KEYWORD_TerminationTradeDate_Columns, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as TRADE_KEYWORD_TerminationTradeDate_Columns
,[CounterParty_Full_Name]
,[TRADE_KEYWORD_TrustRole]
,[TRADE_KEYWORD_TrustAccount]
,[CBCAttribute_TrustAccountSixDigits]
,[CounterParty_Attribute_CLASSIFICATION]
,[Trade_Type]
,[Trade_Currency]
,[Name]
,[PRODUCT_CODE_ISIN]
,[PRODUCT_CODE_CBC_BondType]
,[Issuer]
,[Issuer_Attr_Industry_Type]
,convert(date,[Issued_Date]) as Issued_Date
,convert(date,[Next_Coupon_Date]) as Next_Coupon_Date
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Coupon],' ',''),''),0)) as Coupon
,[Coupon_Frequency]
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Nominal],' ',''),''),0)) as Nominal
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Trade_Price],' ',''),''),0)) as Trade_Price
,[Yield]
,[TRADE_KEYWORD_AssetSwapYield]
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([SettlementAmount],' ',''),''),0)) as SettlementAmount
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Fee_FI_TBC_COMM_FEE_Amount],' ',''),''),0)) as Fee_FI_TBC_COMM_FEE_Amount
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Fee_FI_ODB_FEE_Amount],' ',''),''),0)) as Fee_FI_ODB_FEE_Amount
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Fee_FI_CUST_MAIN_FEE_Amount],' ',''),''),0)) as Fee_FI_CUST_MAIN_FEE_Amount
,[TRADE_KEYWORD_ClientName_ID]
,[TRADE_KEYWORD_ClientAccount_Account_Name]
,[CBCAttribute_ClientAccount_AccountNameSixDigits]
,[TRADE_KEYWORD_CouponReceivingAcct_Account_Name]
,[CBCAttribute_CouponReceivingAcct_AccountNameSixDigits]
,[Principal_Currency]
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Principal_Amount],' ',''),''),0)) as Principal_Amount
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Fixed_Rate],' ',''),''),0)) as Fixed_Rate
,[Accrual_Method]
,[Payment_DayCount]
,[Payment_Freq]
,[Coupon_Holidays]
,[TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TradeType]
,[CounterParty_Attribute_CBC_MM_TAXExempt]
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Pricer_WITHHOLDINGTAX_AM],' ',''),''),0)) as Pricer_WITHHOLDINGTAX_AM
,convert(numeric(32,10),ISNULL(NULLIF(busc.func_removeNonNumeric(Pricer_PRICE),''),0)) as [Pricer_PRICE]
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Fee_MM_DST_INT_FEE_Amount],' ',''),''),0)) as Fee_MM_DST_INT_FEE_Amount
,[Currency_Pair]
,[Prim_Cur]
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Prim_Amt],' ',''),''),0)) as Prim_Amt
,[FX_Spot_Rate]
,[FX_Fwd_Pts]
,[TRADE_KEYWORD_SPOT_MARGIN]
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([FX_Near_Margin],' ',''),''),0)) as FX_Near_Margin
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([FX_Near_AllIn_Rate],' ',''),''),0)) as FX_Near_AllIn_Rate
,[Sec_Cur]
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Sec_Amt],' ',''),''),0)) as Sec_Amt
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([FX_Far_Prim_Amount],' ',''),''),0)) as FX_Far_Prim_Amount
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([FX_Far_Margin],' ',''),''),0)) as FX_Far_Margin
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([FX_Far_AllIn_Rate],' ',''),''),0)) as FX_Far_AllIn_Rate
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([FX_Far_Sec_Amount],' ',''),''),0)) as FX_Far_Sec_Amount
,[Pay_Leg_Principal_Ccy]
,[Pay_Leg_Type]
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Pay_Leg_Principal],' ',''),''),0)) as Pay_Leg_Principal
,convert(date,[Pay_Leg_Start_Date]) as Pay_Leg_Start_Date
,convert(date,[Pay_Leg_Maturity_Date]) as Pay_Leg_Maturity_Date
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Pay_Leg_Fixed_Rate],' ',''),''),0)) as Pay_Leg_Fixed_Rate
,[Pay_Leg_Floating_Rate]
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Pay_Leg_Index_Factor],' ',''),''),0)) as Pay_Leg_Index_Factor
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Pay_Leg_Rate_Index_Spread],' ',''),''),0)) as Pay_Leg_Rate_Index_Spread
,[Pay_Leg_Has_Prin_Exch_Amort]
,[Pay_Leg_Has_Prin_Exch_Final]
,[Pay_Leg_Has_Prin_Exch_Intial]
,[Pay_Leg_DayCount]
,[Pay_Leg_Payment_Frequency]
,[Pay_Leg_Amortization_Frequency]
,[Pay_Leg_Accrual_Bus_Day_Calendar]
,[Pay_Leg_Accrual_Bus_Day_Convention]
,[Pay_Leg_Fixing_Business_Day_Convention]
,[Pay_Leg_Fixing_Days]
,[Pay_Leg_Reset_Business_Day_Convention]
,[Pay_Leg_Reset_Frequency]
,[CCS_Pay_Interest_Stub]
,[Pay_Schedule_Period_Rule]
,[Prin_Sched_Type]
,[Rcv_Leg_Principal_Ccy]
,[Rcv_Leg_Type]
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Rcv_Leg_Principal],' ',''),''),0)) as Rcv_Leg_Principal
,convert(date,[Rcv_Leg_Start_Date]) as Rcv_Leg_Start_Date
,convert(date,[Rcv_Leg_Maturity_Date]) as Rcv_Leg_Maturity_Date
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Rcv_Leg_Fixed_Rate],' ',''),''),0)) as Rcv_Leg_Fixed_Rate
,[Rcv_Leg_Floating_Rate]
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Rec_Leg_Index_Factor],' ',''),''),0)) as Rec_Leg_Index_Factor
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Rcv_Leg_Rate_Index_Spread],' ',''),''),0)) as Rcv_Leg_Rate_Index_Spread
,[Rec_Leg_Has_Prin_Exch_Amort]
,[Rec_Leg_Has_Prin_Exch_Final]
,[Rec_Leg_Has_Prin_Exch_Intial]
,[Rcv_Leg_DayCount]
,[Rcv_Leg_Payment_Frequency]
,[Rec_Leg_Amortization_Frequency]
,[Rcv_Leg_Accrual_Bus_Day_Calendar]
,[Rcv_Leg_Accrual_Bus_Day_Convention]
,[Rcv_Leg_Fixing_Business_Day_Convention]
,[Rcv_Leg_Fixing_Days]
,[Rcv_Leg_Reset_Business_Day_Convention]
,[Rcv_Leg_Reset_Frequency]
,[CCS_Rec_Interest_Stub]
,[Rec_Schedule_Period_Rule]
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TRADE_KEYWORD_SalesMargin],' ',''),''),0)) as TRADE_KEYWORD_SalesMargin
,convert(date,[TRADE_KEYWORD_FinalMatDate_Columns]) as TRADE_KEYWORD_FinalMatDate_Columns
,[Trade_Comment]
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Pay_Leg_Outstanding_Notional],' ',''),''),0)) as Pay_Leg_Outstanding_Notional
,[Pay_Leg_Settle_Currency]
,convert(numeric(32,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([Rcv_Leg_Outstanding_Notional],' ',''),''),0)) as Rcv_Leg_Outstanding_Notional
,[Receive_Leg_Settle_Currency]
,[Settle_Cur_]
,[TRADE_KEYWORD_OrigTrade]
,[TRADE_KEYWORD_OrigTradeDt]
,[TRADE_KEYWORD_RolledBackTo]
,[TRADE_KEYWORD_Status_of_Securities]
,convert(date,[TRADE_KEYWORD_TerminationDate_Columns]) as TRADE_KEYWORD_TerminationDate_Columns
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(Updated_Date, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as Updated_Date
,[Entered_User]
,[Trader]
,[Sales_Person]
,[Book_Attr_ProfitCenter]
,[TRADE_KEYWORD_BookingBranch]
,[TRADE_KEYWORD_Wealth_Cluster]
,[TRADE_KEYWORD_Wealth_RM]
,TRADE_KEYWORD_ClientName_Full_Name
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[TRY_TRADES_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [D360].[STG_TRY_TRADES] STG ON DELTA.Trade_Id = STG.Trade_Id 
 where H = 'D'
